summary: Cardinal Infrastructure Group Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that subsidiary Cardinal Civil Contracting, LLC amended its October 1, 2025 credit agreement with Truist Bank as administrative agent. The September 10, 2026 Second Amendment establishes a $250 million delayed draw term loan facility and raises revolving commitments from $75 million to $100 million, with other provisions modified; the parent is not a party. No special-situation transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is stated. This is a routine credit-facility expansion, so no deal terms and no risk-arb angle apply.
